verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a code library driven entirely through a documented programmatic API. The evidence shows published TypeDoc class references (e.g. NullEngine), headless server-side execution, NPM ES6 modules with TypeScript typings, and llms.txt files on both doc sites. Community comments praise the documentation and backward compatibility, and the runtime probe confirms the actively published @babylonjs/core package. Missing for 10: no machine-readable API spec (all OpenAPI paths 404), no official MCP or agent-facing surface, and docs are client-rendered with no markdown mirrors, which limits agent consumption.
